parameters.content:
## Invoice Processing Automation
Turn invoice text from email, WhatsApp photos or folder drops into checked, ready-to-post accounting entries.

POST invoice text (OCR output from email, WhatsApp photos or a folder watcher) as `{source, text}` or a list. Each invoice is extracted, its arithmetic checked, duplicates and unknown suppliers flagged. Clean invoices go to a Google Sheet; the rest go to Slack with the reason.

**Try it:** click *Test workflow* to run on the sample data. Then connect your credentials on the output nodes and activate.

Code and docs: github.com/Princewill106/invoice-processing-automation
